2026-08-02.patch_summary: This patch adds a self-test to verify the accuracy of the vm_util folio-order detection helpers, is_backed_by_folio() and is_range_backed_by_folio_orders(). The test faults in memory with only one THP order enabled at a time and checks that the helpers report exactly that order. This ensures that the helpers agree with the kernel's idea of the backing before khugepaged mTHP tests rely on them.
